Title: ERP customer creation trigger remains unsettled (UPGRADED)
Description: Discovery contains tension between CIS-triggered creation and first-order-triggered creation in Acumatica. Unresolved after 12 sessions; affects Customer entity creation, Acumatica sync, dealer activation, and reporting qualification rules.
Response_or_Decision: Run the Release 0 architecture decision gate with Product, Finance, and Acumatica SME. Default planning position remains first-order trigger with CRM-only pre-order onboarding. Update onboarding, portal eligibility, reporting qualification, and INT-001 after sign-off.

Title: Acumatica API readiness may delay critical path
Description: Core customer, pricing, transaction, and consignment streams depend on sandbox access and endpoint readiness.
Response_or_Decision: Escalate sandbox and auth access early, certify representative endpoints, and prove queue/DLQ behavior before any sync wave scales beyond mock contracts.
Linked_Artifact: PROJECT_BREAKDOWN_DETAILED.csv / INT-001 to INT-007 / DEP-003 / Release 0 gate

Title: Historical data quality is inconsistent across legacy systems
Description: Dynamics, HubSpot, Map My Customer, Dropbox, and QuickBooks contain duplicate, incomplete, or differently-structured records.
Response_or_Decision: Profile early, classify by confidence, and preserve archive-only decisions where history is too weak for trusted migration.

Title: Consignment site counts conflict across source documents (UPGRADED)
Description: Research materials reference different totals for active and total consignment locations. Affects Consignment entity master data, INT-007 sync contract, and audit baseline. Must reconcile before site enrollment workflow design.
Response_or_Decision: Reconcile against Warehouse Tracking Master: (1) Get current Acumatica warehouse list for consignment sites (C-{TYPE}-{CITY} naming), (2) Cross-check exited/new tabs for accuracy, (3) Validate site counts in research materials, (4) Publish authoritative Consignment Site Master with reconciliation memo. Lock before DEP-011 (consignment audit scheduler) begins.

Title: Dealer payment provider model is unresolved
Description: The business currently uses separate US and Canada processors, which affects portal payment scope and compliance design.
Response_or_Decision: Select provider pattern or defer portal payments while preserving account visibility.

Title: Outlook/Microsoft 365 approval may slip
Description: Calendar and email sync depend on OAuth approval, tenant policy, and security review.
Response_or_Decision: Request application approval early and keep workflow usable with manual fallback during pilot.

Title: Training portal may not expose usable integration capability
Description: Certification integration is valuable but depends on external API or export support.
Response_or_Decision: Plan CSV/file import fallback and keep core training proof independent of live certification sync.

Title: Dealer company-wide visibility needs careful access rules
Description: Moving from Shopify contact-level accounts to shared company visibility increases sensitivity around access control.
Response_or_Decision: Pilot with representative accounts, confirm account-admin model, and document access delegation rules.

Title: Mobile offline merge behavior may reduce adoption if not handled well
Description: Field users need reliable offline workflows; weak conflict handling will recreate trust problems from current tools.
Response_or_Decision: Constrain editable offline scope first and make sync conflicts explicit and reviewable.

Title: Reporting can fail approval even if core workflows exist
Description: Research repeatedly positions dynamic reporting as the top approval gate.
Response_or_Decision: Treat reporting semantic layer and five priority report families as protected P0 scope.

Title: Acumatica remains financial system of record
Description: Financial truth, invoice status, credit hold, and pricing source data remain ERP-owned.
Response_or_Decision: Design CRM around operational ownership and ERP-aligned sync boundaries.

Title: Residential CRM scope leads the program
Description: Commercial CRM is enabled architecturally but does not drive residential Phase 1 control decisions.
Response_or_Decision: Keep commercial workstream separated and later-sequenced unless sponsor changes scope.

Title: Widen stays boundary-scoped, not a full CRM DAM replacement
Description: CRM should host in-scope sales and dealer assets but not absorb all enterprise DAM responsibility.
Response_or_Decision: Use curated import only and maintain boundary documentation.

Title: Inventory validation remains non-blocking at order submission
Description: Dealer orders should be accepted even when real-time inventory certainty is imperfect.
Response_or_Decision: Keep order acceptance non-blocking while surfacing shipment and backorder visibility from ERP.

Title: Field-level mapping has not yet been approved (UPGRADED)
Description: The WBS and control package define entity-level scope, but field-by-field mappings are still pending. Discovered during audit: no Acumatica SKU ↔ CRM Product ↔ Widen asset linkage exists; Customer field mapping unknown; Contact lifecycle unmapped. Blocks database schema, form validation, and test data.
Response_or_Decision: See RAID-029 for detailed closure. Priority order: (1) Customer entity (blocks DEP-003), (2) Products (blocks INT-002), (3) Pricing (blocks INT-003), (4) Consignment (blocks INT-007), (5) Contact (blocks DEP-004), (6) Orders (blocks INT-004), (7) Reporting (blocks KPI definitions). Create mapping workbooks with transformation rules, defaults, required vs optional. Target completion: Apr 1, 2026.
Linked_Artifact: MIG-005 to MIG-016 / INT-001 to INT-007 / RAID-029

Title: Master-data stewardship roster is not assigned
Description: Reference data quality will drift without named owners for affinity groups, ownership groups, classes, and categories.
Response_or_Decision: Assign business stewards and include them in sign-off gates.

Title: No approved cutover environment schedule exists
Description: Rehearsal dates, freeze windows, and environment promotion rules are not yet fixed.
Response_or_Decision: Adopt the cutover and validation plan with at least one full rehearsal.

Title: WBS sequence is control ordering, not sprint commitment
Description: The `Seq 01` to `Seq 06` values in the WBS represent dependency-aware build order rather than promised sprint dates.
Response_or_Decision: Use the dependency register and stage gates for schedule control; build sprint plan separately.

Title: Report builder and five priority report families are protected scope
Description: Reporting is treated as approval-gate functionality rather than optional polish.
Response_or_Decision: Do not trade away reporting semantic layer, report builder, scheduled reports, or priority templates without sponsor approval.

Title: Rebates and complex settlement stay outside CRM
Description: CRM may surface outcomes and statuses, but rebate engine and refund settlement remain outside scope.
Response_or_Decision: Keep ERP or external finance tools responsible for rebate computation and refund settlement.
Linked_Artifact: Pricing & ERP-Dependent Commercial Rules > Boundary Decisions

Title: Dealer group and price class can be conflated
Description: If dealer catalog group, brand visibility, and price class are not kept separate, the wrong catalog, wrong files, or wrong pricing can be shown to a dealer account.
Response_or_Decision: Keep dealer-group resolution separate from price-class logic and test representative dealer accounts across affinity, ownership, and region variations.
Linked_Artifact: Product Management & Dealer Catalog Governance / DEP-030 / DEP-033

Title: KPI definitions may diverge across dashboards and reports
Description: The meetings still leave room for different interpretations of active account, first-order-ready, overdue training, consignment current state, and dealer engagement metrics.
Trigger_or_Date: Before dashboard UAT and executive sign-off
Response_or_Decision: Publish a metric definition register and require semantic-layer sign-off before final dashboard validation.

Title: Widen replacement scope can expand beyond the validated workflow (UPGRADED)
Description: The meetings support replacing Dropbox hunts and covering the product/dealer asset workflow, but they do not support promising a full enterprise Widen replacement without another decision. Risk: scope creep into full DAM without explicit governance or new decision. No boundary enforcement mechanism exists.
Trigger_or_Date: Before Digital Assets production design is frozen
Response_or_Decision: Document Widen boundary in scope control: (1) IN scope: Pulse-owned product/dealer assets, branded file serving, dealer-group file filtering, asset versioning, in-scope workflows (product launches, dealer campaigns), (2) OUT of scope: Enterprise-wide Widen replacement, non-product DAM, brand compliance governance, rights management, multi-purpose reuse. Create Digital Assets Scope Control document with approval matrix. Add scope control question to all PRD/design reviews: 'Does this asset workflow exist in discovery 12 sessions?' If no = defer to Phase 2 decision.

Title: Product identity mismatch can attach the wrong files to the wrong item (UPGRADED)
Description: Acumatica item IDs, Shopify naming, CSV exports, and branded asset files do not line up cleanly today, creating a wrong-brand or wrong-file risk. Discovered during audit: no canonical SKU-to-asset registry exists; Widen asset IDs unknown; product variant handling undefined.
Owner: Product Lead + Data Lead + Acumatica SME
Response_or_Decision: Create canonical Product Master with: (1) Acumatica item ID (primary key), (2) Shopify product ID (legacy reference), (3) CRM product name, (4) Product status (sellable/preview/archived), (5) Asset linkage (Widen asset ID + Pulse asset ID), (6) Brand/region override rules, (7) Variant strategy (single record vs child records). Build item-to-asset linkage database with validation rules. Conduct data quality audit on 50+ products before INT-002 (product sync) begins. Lock before MIG-021 (product migration).
Linked_Artifact: MIG-021 / INT-002 / INT-023 / Product Management & Dealer Catalog Governance / INT-022

Title: Dealer portal does not expose stock counts or shipment scheduling as core scope
Description: The meetings support dealer access to orders, shipments, invoices, statements, payments, pricing, products, and files, but not dealer-facing stock visibility or shipment scheduling as a core workflow.
Response_or_Decision: Keep dealer portal focused on catalog, pricing, ordering, account center, tracking, and files. Show shipment status and history, but remove shipment scheduling from core scope.
Linked_Artifact: Dealer Portal Replacement for Shopify / Meeting session 11 feedback

Title: Frontend prototype cannot ship to production as-is
Description: Frontend codebase is 147K LOC with 226 components but 0% real API integration (all mocked), <5% test coverage, 143 console.log debug statements, and placeholder authentication. Cannot be deployed to production database without comprehensive refactoring.
Response_or_Decision: Complete 60-80 hour refactoring: (1) Remove MockDataProvider and all 676 lines of fake data, (2) Implement real API integration layer, (3) Remove all 143 console.log statements, (4) Add error boundaries and Sentry integration, (5) Reach 60% test coverage on critical paths. Extract giant components (LeadPipeline 74KB, CISForm 47KB). Lock Next.js to stable GA (v16 not canary).

Title: 242 TBD items (80% of WBS) have no structured validation plan
Description: 302 WBS rows include 242 items marked TBD with no closure timeline, validation strategy, or acceptance criteria. Scope can expand/contract mid-sprint without structured capture.
Response_or_Decision: Execute 4-week VALIDATION_AND_MAPPING_ROADMAP: Phase 1 (Week 1): Foundation + P0 kickoff (20h), Phase 2 (Week 2): Session 3 rerun + P0 deep-dive (29h), Phase 3 (Week 3): P1 completion + async responses (31h), Phase 4 (Week 4): Sessions 8, 12 reruns + final closures (28h). Target closure: Apr 25, 2026. Create METRIC_DEFINITION_REGISTER for all 19 KPIs. Close all 242 TBD mappings.

Title: Database schema (Prisma models) not yet generated from ERD
Description: System ERD Blueprint defines 110+ entities conceptually, but no Prisma schema, DDL, or field-level detail exists. Backend devs cannot create tables, write queries, or set up migrations.
Response_or_Decision: Generate complete Prisma schema covering all 110+ entities with: (1) Field definitions + types + nullability + defaults, (2) Relationships + cascade behavior, (3) Index strategy for performance, (4) Soft-delete vs hard-delete decisions per entity, (5) Encryption field definitions (PCI, PHI), (6) Audit trail schema. Finalize FOUNDATION_SECURITY_ADMIN decisions on field-level masking before schema lock.

Title: Field-level mappings for 7 core entities still not created
Description: RAID-015 identified this; discovery completed 12 sessions but no detailed Customer, Lead, Pricing, Consignment, Account, Contact, Order field mapping workbooks exist. No mapping authority = no validation = no agreement on what data is synced.
Response_or_Decision: Deliver the signed field-mapping workbooks added to Seq 02 for Customer, Contact, Product, Pricing, Consignment, Order, and Reporting. Include transforms, defaults, conflict rules, and sign-off before schema and sync implementation proceed.

Title: Canary Next.js version locks frontend to pre-release software
Description: package.json specifies Next.js v16.1.0-canary.16 (pre-release), not stable GA. Production deployment on canary version is unsupported and carries stability risk.
Response_or_Decision: Upgrade to Next.js 16 GA (or latest stable 16.x). Test build and dev server with stable version. Pin version in package.json and package-lock.json. Add pre-commit hook to block canary versions.

Title: Message queue infrastructure (pg-boss) not yet provisioned
Description: MESSAGE_QUEUE_AND_ASYNC_PATTERN selected PostgreSQL pg-boss for 5-tier queue (CRITICAL/HIGH/STANDARD/BATCH/DLQ) supporting 26 integrations, but no queue infrastructure, job schema, or test framework exists.
Response_or_Decision: Provision pg-boss infrastructure: (1) Create job table schema + monitoring schema, (2) Implement 5-tier queue with exponential backoff (max 300s, 30*2^(attempt-1)), (3) Build monitoring dashboard (queue depth, latency p50/p95/p99, DLQ size), (4) Create unit + integration tests for queue patterns, (5) Define queue SLAs per tier (CRITICAL: 5min, HIGH: 15min, STANDARD: 1hr, BATCH: 24hr). Test with mock Acumatica jobs.

Title: Mobile offline conflict resolution UX under-specified
Description: RAID-009 flagged offline merge risk; MOBILE_APP_SUPPLEMENT details 11 error scenarios but merge conflict UX (side-by-side review, version selection, cascading resolution) is conceptual only. Risk of low adoption if UX is friction-heavy.
Response_or_Decision: Complete detailed storyboards for offline sync conflicts: (1) Detection logic (last_updated_by + timestamp + version hash), (2) UI mockups for 3 conflict types (add/update conflict, delete conflict, circular conflict), (3) Merge resolution strategies (use mine / use server / manual merge), (4) Cascade behavior (resolve all conflicts before continuing), (5) Logging/audit trail. Conduct user testing with 3-5 field TMs.

Title: Production readiness artifacts incomplete before UAT
Description: Testing & Quality Strategy targets 70% unit / 40% integration / 20% E2E coverage but test suites not yet built. Security Architecture, Deployment Pipeline, and Cost Model are documented but not validated against real infrastructure.
Response_or_Decision: Complete Release 3 pilot-readiness and Release 4 cutover gates: role UAT, non-functional testing, reconciliation, runbooks, support command center, and go/no-go evidence before GA.

Title: Pilot and GA control model may remain procedural instead of operational
Description: The updated WBS and release plan now require named pilot cohorts, support tiers, runbooks, and GA go/no-go thresholds. If those controls are not turned into operating artifacts before pilot start, rollout risk remains high even if features are built.
Response_or_Decision: Operationalize the pilot-governance, support-command-center, and role-runbook work packages before pilot launch; require evidence at the G3 and G4 go/no-go gates.
